text_block_list.text:
On this day, a diverse crowd had gathered
at Hanshin Racecourse for the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh~, it's already GⅠ season
for the girls who debuted this year~!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Now, the race to decide the Junior-tier champion.
I wonder who will claim their first GⅠ victory...?

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, yikes. So many people.
Is there a festival or something?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this race gonna be seriously insane??
Like, wouldn't it be wild if that girl runs in it too~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I...
didn't make it in time to the heart of this heat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Palmer was resting due to a fracture,
and McQueen had yet to make her debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I was the only one
who could carry the Mejiro name
and take on that challenge...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I was the overwhelming favorite in the race before that...
and I lost."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"If only McQueen had made it in time,
it wouldn't have turned out like this. As a Mejiro, she would've run a magnificent race...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I still haven't been able to become a Mejiro Umamusume
like that girl...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Sister Ryan~.
I found some delicious-looking soft-serve ice cream~. Let's split it~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
! Bright!?
When did you even go and buy that!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Kyaah!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: !? Bright—
(Squelch!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Thank goodness, I caught you before you fell.
Are you hurt?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. But the soft serve is on
your leg, Onee-sama...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all.
More importantly, I'm glad I could support you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Must be thanks to all that constant training.
Seems explosive power is the one thing I've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Ryan-oneesama.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I do not believe that instantaneous acceleration
is the only gift you possess, dear sister~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I've watched you ever since I was little. Seeing you, Ryan-oneesama, running around the Mejiro gardens first thing in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"She was expected to be faster than anyone,
expected to be stronger than anyone,
and worked harder than anyone."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ――She's the one I admire so much, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Bright.

This time, Ines Fujin is taking on her very first GⅠ race,
the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, look, look! This is amazing!
They're airing a special on the Asahi Hai on TV right now!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"My little sisters sent this to me!
Look! You can see me right here, super tiny!"

...To be honest, compared to the other Umamusume,
Ines Fujin has a hard time doing independent training,
so it's hard to say she's had enough practice time.
Even so, running in this race is ultimately for the sake of the Derby. The intention is just to give her GⅠ experience, but—

—They say some girls have their spirits broken in their first GⅠ,
crushed by the sheer gap between them and the rest.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...? Hellooo, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-Yeah...?
choice_data_list: Even if you lose, don't get discouraged—just focus on gaining experience!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh...!
I see, mm-hmm~."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Heheh, ahaha!
Hey, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's totally obvious what you're thinking!
You're worrying way too much! Geez!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If you keep making that face,
your anxiety's gonna rub off on me too, you know?
Is that what you want? Me shivering and shaking~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Right? So stop making that worried face already!
Come on, give me that smug grin of yours.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"If it's my Umamusume, she's bound to take 1st place!"
...Go on, say it!
choice_data_list: My Umamusume should definitely be able to take 1st place...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Good enough!
Now I just want you to watch from the stands
with a smug, proud face.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: How strong this big sis really is!
